resolutions.researcher_notes: Single direct source with an explicit groundbreaking date matching the sheet exactly. chyxx.com (2008-08, https://www.chyxx.com/industry/200808/2143827QU5.html, verified for '553') reports the project's approval/investment ~2 months earlier (Aug 2008) as context but does not itself state a construction-start date, so it is supporting context rather than a second independent confirmation of the Oct 2008 date -- tier held at medium, independent:false per rule 4 rather than inflating to high on a single dispositive source.

VALIDITY: P4777's Length (825.00km) and SegmentCost (3.1B RMB) cannot be confirmed or confidently replaced -- six independent-host length figures for 'Phase I' range 553km (2008 announced plan, chyxx) / 680km (2008 groundbreaking design figure, sohu) / 825km (sheet) / 860km (2022, main trunk excl. branches, CCXI) / 876km (main trunk total, petrobest) / 1,092km (2022 cumulative commissioned incl. branches, CCXI), and cost is 1.691B RMB (2022 audited, incl. branches, CCXI) vs. sheet's 3.1B RMB. These likely mix different definitions (announced plan vs. as-built mainline vs. mainline+branches network total) rather than being simple corrections, and no single source reproduces the sheet's exact figures. Recommend human review of what 825.00km/3.1B RMB in the sheet actually represents (e.g. a specific bond-financed tranche, or a stale planning-stage figure) before touching either cell. Not recommending any value change absent that review.
